summary: PureTech Health plc filed a Form 6-K announcing its intention to voluntarily delist its American Depositary Shares (ADSs) from Nasdaq, concentrating its listing on the London Stock Exchange. The board determined that duallisting no longer benefits shareholders, as the majority of trading volume, liquidity, and price discovery occurs on the LSE. The delisting is expected to become effective on or about May 20, 2026, after filing a Form 25. Post-delisting, ADSs are expected to trade OTC via a Level 1 ADR program, with potential future termination of the ADR program. The company will file a Form 15F to terminate SEC reporting obligations. This is a voluntary delisting without any price or premium terms; the focus is on operational simplification and cost savings. Watch for the Form 25 filing and the transition to OTC trading; risk includes shareholders needing to manage OTC liquidity and the potential for ADR program termination.
